correctness.rationale: For q=2^k, the exact quadratic Fourier sum G_k(U,V) is 0 when U is odd (translate x by q/2); for U even and V odd its squared magnitude is 2q (direct difference h=x-y); for U,V both even G_k=2G_(k-1). At k=1 the zero condition is U+V odd. Orthogonal restricted characters split into q/2 u-even and q/2 u-odd translation eigenspaces, and within each block v-parity is fixed by the nonzero-even-U/odd-V case. Dividing block coordinates by two gives two arbitrary smaller spectra, and conversely the lift gives a full orthogonal basis. This proves the exact bijective recursion N_k=4 N_(k-1)^2 and N_k=2^(2^(k+1)-2), and inductively extends EVERY partial orthogonal set; not extrapolated from finite cliques. k=1 and q=2 are handled.
